title: NASA-UAP-D2, Apollo 17 Transcript, 1972
doc_notes: This document is a transcript of Apollo 17 air-to-ground communications documenting reports of unidentified visual phenomena observed by the crew.

incidents.summary: Astronauts observed bright, tumbling particles drifting near the spacecraft during a maneuver.
incidents.explanation: Astronauts speculated they were ice or paint fragments from the S-IVB rocket stage.
incidents.quote: Now we've got a few very bright particles or fragments or something that go drifting by as we maneuver.

incidents.summary: Astronauts reported observing flashing, rotating objects and streaks of light while in space.
incidents.explanation: Astronauts speculated they were SLA panels or other separated spacecraft components.
incidents.quote: It is a bright object, and it's obviously rotating because it's flashing.

incidents.summary: Astronaut observed a flash of light on the lunar surface north of Grimaldi crater.
incidents.explanation: Astronaut suggested it could be a small impact.
incidents.quote: Hey, I just saw a flash on the lunar surface!
